title: Insured Plan of Care Credits and Coinsurance Still to Come from Explanations of Benefits
content:
**Payer program note — Insured Plan of Care credits.** Coinsurance still to come from explanations of benefits not yet received is held back from the credit standing on a plan over a window that follows the payer program's refund period:

- On a payer program that bills coinsurance after the explanation of benefits and must refund a credit within the short refund period of **30 calendar days** or sooner, the hold is the coinsurance percentage on file times the allowed amounts of the visits dated within the last month, less the coinsurance charges posted for visits dated within that month.
- On a payer program that bills coinsurance after the explanation of benefits and allows longer than the 30-day short refund period, the same is counted over the visits dated within the last two months.
- On a payer program that does not bill coinsurance after the explanation of benefits, nothing is held for coinsurance still to come.

The hold is never below zero and is rounded half up to the cent. A visit is dated within the last N months when fewer than N whole calendar months separate its date of service from today. The amount held is taken off the credit together with any other amount held back from it, and what remains is never below zero.

| Payer program | Coinsurance billed after the explanation of benefits | Credit refund period | Window counted |
|---|---|---|---|
| Commercial PPO Plan of Care | Yes | 30 days | Last month |
| Commercial High-Deductible Plan of Care | Yes | 30 days | Last month |
| Commercial POS Plan of Care | No | 30 days | Nothing held |
| Commercial HMO Plan of Care | No | 30 days | Nothing held |
| Medicare Part B Plan of Care | Yes | 60 days | Last two months |
| Medicare Advantage Plan of Care | No | 60 days | Nothing held |
| Medicaid Managed Care Plan of Care | No | 60 days | Nothing held |

## Window edges (hypothetical, today 2026-06-15)

| Date of service | Whole calendar months to today | Within the last month | Within the last two months |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-05-16 | 0 | Yes | Yes |
| 2026-05-15 | 1 | No | Yes |
| 2026-04-16 | 1 | No | Yes |
| 2026-04-15 | 2 | No | No |

## Worked hold (hypothetical Commercial PPO plan, coinsurance 20%)

Visits dated within the last month were allowed at $120.00 and $130.00, together $250.00; 20% of that is $50.00. A coinsurance charge of $24.00 has been posted for one of those visits. The hold is $50.00 less $24.00, that is $26.00.
